Anyone got a good recipe that hides vegetables?

When I was a kid (Italian) my family would get me to eat my peas by cooking them with shell pasta (they used to use penne, but I kept blowing the peas out like it was a straw). It worked, now I love peas.

As @BBQue suggested there are tons of ways to put vegetables in the food in a non-traditional way that someone might not even notice.

If however your SO picks up on that you're basically treating him like a child, there are two good solutions: fry it, or add bacon.

My gf hates zucchini, but LOVES my fried zucchini. You can fry all sorts of vegetables like cauliflower, broccoli, zucchini, snap peas, etc. Just make sure to salt them a couple hours before you fry them to draw out the moisture. Then just dredge them in flour, then egg, then fry them in olive oil/preferred oil.

Some vegetables go extremely well with bacon, like fava beans or peas. Chop up the bacon so that everything in the recipe has bacon goodness evenly throughout, and he may just see eating the vegetables as worth it to get the bacon.
Everyone loves bacon! Great suggestion thank you!
